popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Virgil makes Dardanus the ancestral founder behind Troy and Aeneas — the Samothracian-born son of Zeus and Electra whose line becomes Rome's claim on Ilium.

popCulture.title: Dardanus
popCulture.description: Son of Zeus and the Pleiad Electra, founder of Dardania — the eponym whose name still marks the Dardanelles and the Trojan royal stem.
